SELECT s.id, s.goods_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, g.goods_name, s.barcode, s.unit_id, u.unit_name, s.spec_info, s.spec_ids, s.purchase_price, s.sale_price, s.wholesale_price, s.cost_price, s.min_stock, s.max_stock, COALESCE(s.image, g.image) AS image, COALESCE(SUM(st.quantity), 0) AS stock, s.status, s.create_time FROM wms_goods_sku s LEFT JOIN wms_unit u ON s.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON s.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN wms_stock st ON s.id = st.sku_id
s.del_flag = '0'
AND s.goods_id = #{reqVO.goodsId}
AND s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.skuCode}, '%')
AND s.sku_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.skuName}, '%')
AND g.category_id = #{reqVO.categoryId}
AND g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.goodsCode}, '%')
AND g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.goodsName}, '%')
AND (s.sku_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR s.spec_info LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR s.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%') OR s.barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reqVO.keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY s.id, s.goods_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, g.goods_name, s.barcode, s.unit_id, u.unit_name, s.spec_info, s.spec_ids, s.purchase_price, s.sale_price, s.wholesale_price, s.cost_price, s.min_stock, s.max_stock, s.image, g.image, s.status, s.create_time ORDER BY s.create_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT s.id, s.goods_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, g.goods_name, s.barcode, s.unit_id, u.unit_name, s.spec_info, s.spec_ids, s.purchase_price, s.sale_price, s.wholesale_price, s.cost_price, s.min_stock, s.max_stock, COALESCE(s.image, g.image) AS image, COALESCE(SUM(st.quantity), 0) AS stock, s.status, s.create_time FROM wms_goods_sku s LEFT JOIN wms_unit u ON s.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON s.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN wms_stock st ON s.id = st.sku_id
s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0' AND (g.status IS NULL OR g.status = '0')
AND
s.sku_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') OR s.spec_info LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%') OR g.goods_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{token}, '%')
GROUP BY s.id, s.goods_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, g.goods_name, s.barcode, s.unit_id, u.unit_name, s.spec_info, s.spec_ids, s.purchase_price, s.sale_price, s.wholesale_price, s.cost_price, s.min_stock, s.max_stock, s.image, g.image, s.status, s.create_time ORDER BY s.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.goods_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, g.goods_name, s.barcode, s.unit_id, u.unit_name, s.spec_info, s.spec_ids, s.purchase_price, s.sale_price, s.wholesale_price, s.cost_price, s.min_stock, s.max_stock, COALESCE(s.image, g.image) AS image, COALESCE(SUM(st.quantity), 0) AS stock, s.status, s.create_time FROM wms_goods_sku s LEFT JOIN wms_unit u ON s.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN wms_goods g ON s.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN wms_stock st ON s.id = st.sku_id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY s.id, s.goods_id, s.sku_code, s.sku_name, g.goods_name, s.barcode, s.unit_id, u.unit_name, s.spec_info, s.spec_ids, s.purchase_price, s.sale_price, s.wholesale_price, s.cost_price, s.min_stock, s.max_stock, s.image, g.image, s.status, s.create_time
SELECT sku_code FROM wms_goods_sku WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND sku_code LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') ORDER BY sku_code DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM wms_goods_sku WHERE sku_code = #{skuCode} AND del_flag = 0
AND id != #{excludeId}
